p: together in unity: Because the greatest part was against David, though some favoured him, yet when he was established king at length, they joined all together like brothers: and therefore he shows by these similarities the convenience of brotherly love.
ointment upon the head: The ointment was a figure of the graces which come from Christ the head of his Church.
Hermon: By Hermon and Zion he means the plentiful country about Jerusalem.
there the LORD commanded the blessing: Where there is such concord.
